scope: Selected extracted provisions and retained proposal/advice records, not exhaustive session or mission compliance coverage.
limitations: Selected provisions are not automatically mandatory requirements applicable to every peace operation.
Documentary adoption and repository publication do not establish implementation, owner approval or financial benefit.

metrics.name: Obligation applicability coverage
metrics.definition: Reviewed applicable provisions / extracted provisions; report excluded and unresolved separately
metrics.guardrail: No global compliance score from a selected corpus

metrics.name: Implementation evidence coverage
metrics.definition: Material action components with authenticated implementation evidence / all material components in defined scope
metrics.minimum_evidence: Dated administrative/operational records with coverage assessment
metrics.guardrail: Reported and verified evidence remain separate

metrics.name: Service continuity
metrics.definition: Completed required outputs and timeliness against prospectively specified baseline and intervention periods
metrics.minimum_evidence: Workload, service-level, quality, incident and readiness records
metrics.guardrail: Mandate delivery, safety and readiness must remain within approved thresholds

metrics.name: Full-system net cost
metrics.definition: Comparable counterfactual system cost minus intervention system cost, including transition and transferred work
metrics.minimum_evidence: Matched cost objects, full-system ledger and independent financial review
metrics.guardrail: No savings designation before FINANCIALLY_VALIDATED; no sum across overlapping pools

metrics.name: Capacity released and used
metrics.definition: Observed reusable work hours separated from released payroll or external expenditure
metrics.minimum_evidence: Time observations, staffing and redeployment records
metrics.guardrail: Capacity is not a cashable saving; preserve output quality

metrics.name: Due-action evidence completeness
metrics.definition: Due applicable actions with adequate performance evidence / due applicable actions
metrics.minimum_evidence: Sourced deadlines, applicability review and complete performance population
